newsitem.title: MEXICO: Seven Mexican Gulf ports remain closed - government.
newsitem.headline: Seven Mexican Gulf ports remain closed - government.

text.p: A storm front in the Gulf of Mexico kept seven ports closed on Wednesday at 1600 local time (1700 EDT), the Communications and Transportations Ministry said in its latest meteorological report.

The ministry said the Campeche port in Campeche state was closed on Tuesday night, in addition to six ports earlier reported shut to outgoing ships because of high winds. A representative at the Campeche port estimated the terminal could reopen in the evening as winds die down.
Last night ports were closed in Tuxpan, Veracruz and Coatzacoalcos in Veracruz state, Dos Bocas and Frontera in Tabasco state and Ciudad Carmen in Campeche state.
Gusts in the Gulf of Mexico relaxed from up to 40 knots to maximum winds of 35 knots with waves reaching 12 feet high.
